integrity: All infinite-time conclusions follow from stated comparison and ODE proofs; exact and numerical checker results are supporting diagnostics. No independent scientific audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneously mixed deterministic SIS only, with common supercritical pairwise rate beta>delta and shared recovery; positive initial strain prevalences; random-seed probability uses uniform Dirichlet composition. Not a finite network or finite stochastic epidemic. Diagonal-payoff replicator equivalence raises an explicit originality risk.
title: Exact winner basins and inoculum probabilities in multistrain simplicial SIS dynamics
